newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks seen extending rally on resources.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks seen extending rally on resources.

text.p: * Toronto stocks were expected to continue Friday's rally, pumped up by improving resource shares. * A heavy schedule of data out of the U.S. this week should keep the market cautious.
Toronto stocks were expected to open higher on Monday, pumped up by stronger resource shares, particularly golds and base metals.
The market will also be tightly focused on a raft of U.S. economic data due out this week. Traders said if any of the numbers hint at economic strength, it may spell trouble for the firm bond market.
"We'll of course continue to see strength in rate-sensitives. But what you are seeing coming to life again pretty much with a vengeance are the golds and the base metals," said one trader.
On Friday, the Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index jumped 72.05 points to 6229.52, helped by firm metal and energy stocks.
Gold prices are seen by many analysts as likely to improve. The gleaming metal has seen hitting its bottom for the year and may test US$350 resistance on the top level.
